original:
The following statements hold.

(a) 

Suppose that signed graphs $\Sigma_{1}$ and $\Sigma_{2}$ have exactly one common vertex and no common edges.
Then $\displaystyle Z_{\Sigma_{1}\cup\Sigma_{2}}(q)=\frac{Z_{\Sigma_{1}}(q)Z_{\Sigma_{2}}(q)}{q}$ .
Consequently, if a connected signed graph $\Sigma$ has blocks $B_{1},\ldots,B_{b}$ , then

(2.2)

 $Z_{\Sigma}(q)=q^{1-b}\prod_{i=1}^{b}Z_{B_{i}}(q).$ 

(b) 

Suppose that ordinary graphs $G_{1}$ and $G_{2}$ meet exactly in an edge and its two endpoints. Then

(2.3)

 $P_{G_{1}\cup G_{2}}(q)=\frac{P_{G_{1}}(q)P_{G_{2}}(q)}{q(q-1)}.$

lemma x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux1 (p q : Polynomial ℤ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, p.eval (2 * ((n : ℤ) + 1)) = q.eval (2 * ((n : ℤ) + 1))) :
    p = q := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    intro a b hab
    have hcast : (a : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  apply (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hi).mono
  rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact h n

lemma x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux2 {V C : Type*} [Finite V] [Finite C]
    [AddCommGroup C] (d : C) (P N : SimpleGraph V)
    (S T : Set V) (u : V) (hcover : S ∪ T = Set.univ)
    (hinter : S ∩ T = {u})
    (hedges : ∀ v w, (P ⊔ N).Adj v w →
      (v ∈ S ∧ w ∈ S) ∨ (v ∈ T ∧ w ∈ T)) :
    Nat.card C * Nat.card {c : V → C //
      (∀ v w, P.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
      (∀ v w, N.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)} =
    Nat.card {c : {v : V // v ∈ S} → C //
      (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ S}), (P.induce S).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
      (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ S}), (N.induce S).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)} *
    Nat.card {c : {v : V // v ∈ T} → C //
      (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ T}), (P.induce T).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
      (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ T}), (N.induce T).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)} := by
  classical
  let Valid {W : Type _} (P N : SimpleGraph W) (c : W → C) : Prop :=
    (∀ v w, P.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
    (∀ v w, N.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)
  have shift {W : Type _} {P N : SimpleGraph W} {c : W → C}
      (hc : Valid P N c) (k : C) : Valid P N (fun v => c v + k) := by
    constructor
    · intro v w he h
      exact hc.1 v w he (add_right_cancel h)
    · intro v w he h
      apply hc.2 v w he
      apply add_right_cancel (b := k)
      calc
        c v + k = (c w + k) + d := h
        _ = (c w + d) + k := by abel
  have hu : u ∈ S ∩ T := by rw [hinter]; simp
  let us : S := ⟨u, hu.1⟩
  let ut : T := ⟨u, hu.2⟩
  let A := {c : V → C // Valid P N c}
  let B := {c : {v : V // v ∈ S} → C // Valid (P.induce S) (N.induce S) c}
  let D := {c : {v : V // v ∈ T} → C // Valid (P.induce T) (N.induce T) c}
  have restrictS (c : A) : Valid (P.induce S) (N.induce S) (fun v => c.1 v.1) :=
    ⟨fun v w h => c.2.1 v.1 w.1 h, fun v w h => c.2.2 v.1 w.1 h⟩
  have restrictT (c : A) : Valid (P.induce T) (N.induce T) (fun v => c.1 v.1) :=
    ⟨fun v w h => c.2.1 v.1 w.1 h, fun v w h => c.2.2 v.1 w.1 h⟩
  have memT (v : V) (hv : v ∉ S) : v ∈ T := by
    have h : v ∈ S ∪ T := by rw [hcover]; trivial
    exact h.resolve_left hv
  let glue (s : B) (t : D) (v : V) : C :=
    if hv : v ∈ S then s.1 ⟨v, hv⟩ else
      t.1 ⟨v, memT v hv⟩ + (s.1 us - t.1 ut)
  have glueS (s : B) (t : D) (v : S) : glue s t v.1 = s.1 v := by
    simp [glue, v.2]
  have glueT (s : B) (t : D) (v : T) :
      glue s t v.1 = t.1 v + (s.1 us - t.1 ut) := by
    by_cases hv : v.1 ∈ S
    · have heq : v.1 = u := by
        have h : v.1 ∈ S ∩ T := ⟨hv, v.2⟩
        simpa [hinter] using h
      have hvs : (⟨v.1, hv⟩ : S) = us := Subtype.ext heq
      have hvt : v = ut := Subtype.ext heq
      calc
        glue s t v.1 = s.1 ⟨v.1, hv⟩ := glueS s t ⟨v.1, hv⟩
        _ = s.1 us := congrArg s.1 hvs
        _ = t.1 v + (s.1 us - t.1 ut) := by rw [hvt]; abel
    · simp [glue, hv]
  have glue_valid (s : B) (t : D) : Valid P N (glue s t) := by
    have ht := shift t.2 (s.1 us - t.1 ut)
    constructor
    · intro v w he
      rcases hedges v w (Or.inl he) with hs | ht'
      · simpa only [glueS s t ⟨v, hs.1⟩, glueS s t ⟨w, hs.2⟩]
          using s.2.1 ⟨v, hs.1⟩ ⟨w, hs.2⟩ he
      · simpa only [glueT s t ⟨v, ht'.1⟩, glueT s t ⟨w, ht'.2⟩]
          using ht.1 ⟨v, ht'.1⟩ ⟨w, ht'.2⟩ he
    · intro v w he
      rcases hedges v w (Or.inr he) with hs | ht'
      · simpa only [glueS s t ⟨v, hs.1⟩, glueS s t ⟨w, hs.2⟩]
          using s.2.2 ⟨v, hs.1⟩ ⟨w, hs.2⟩ he
      · simpa only [glueT s t ⟨v, ht'.1⟩, glueT s t ⟨w, ht'.2⟩]
          using ht.2 ⟨v, ht'.1⟩ ⟨w, ht'.2⟩ he
  let e : C × A ≃ B × D :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        (⟨fun v => x.2.1 v.1, restrictS x.2⟩,
         ⟨fun v => x.2.1 v.1 + x.1, shift (restrictT x.2) x.1⟩)
      invFun := fun x =>
        (x.2.1 ut - x.1.1 us, ⟨glue x.1 x.2, glue_valid x.1 x.2⟩)
      left_inv := by
        rintro ⟨k, c⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · dsimp
          abel
        · apply Subtype.ext
          funext v
          dsimp
          by_cases hv : v ∈ S
          · simp [glue, hv]
          · simp only [glue, dif_neg hv]
            abel
      right_inv := by
        rintro ⟨s, t⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · apply Subtype.ext
          funext v
          exact glueS s t v
        · apply Subtype.ext
          funext v
          change glue s t v.1 + (t.1 ut - s.1 us) = t.1 v
          rw [glueT]
          abel }
  simpa only [Nat.card_prod] using Nat.card_congr e

lemma x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux4 {V C : Type*} [Fintype V] [Finite C]
    [AddCommGroup C] (d : C) (P N : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidablePred (fun S : Set V => x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) S)]
    (hconn : (P ⊔ N).Connected) :

      Nat.card {c : V → C //
        (∀ v w, P.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
        (∀ v w, N.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)} =
    Nat.card C * Finset.prod
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Set V => x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) S))
      (fun S => Nat.card {c : {v : V // v ∈ S} → C //
        (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ S}), (P.induce S).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w) ∧
        (∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ S}), (N.induce S).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w + d)}) := by
  sorry

lemma x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux5 {V C : Type*} [Finite V] [Finite C]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (S T : Set V) (a b : V)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (he : G.Adj a b) (hcover : S ∪ T = Set.univ)

    (hedges : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w →
      (v ∈ S ∧ w ∈ S) ∨ (v ∈ T ∧ w ∈ T)) :
    Nat.card C * (Nat.card C - 1) *
      Nat.card {c : V → C // ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w} =
    Nat.card {c : {v : V // v ∈ S} → C // ∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ S}), (G.induce S).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w} *
    Nat.card {c : {v : V // v ∈ T} → C // ∀ (v w : {v : V // v ∈ T}), (G.induce T).Adj v w → c v ≠ c w} := by
  sorry

lemma x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux6 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (n : ℕ) :
    (x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥).eval (2 * ((n : ℤ) + 1)) =
    (Nat.card {c : V → ZMod (2 * (n + 1)) //
      ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → c v ≠ c w} : ℤ) := by
  simpa using x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux3 G ⊥ n

theorem x2611_16458_lem2_1 : (∀ (V : Type*) [Finite V] (P N : SimpleGraph V), (∀ (S T : Set V) (u : V), S ∪ T = Set.univ → S ∩ T = {u} →

    (v ∈ S ∧ w ∈ S) ∨ (v ∈ T ∧ w ∈ T)) →

    x2611_16458_zeroFree (P.induce S) (N.induce S) *
    x2611_16458_zeroFree (P.induce T) (N.induce T)) ∧
  ((P ⊔ N).Connected →
  Polynomial.X ^ Nat.card {S : Set V // x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) S} *
    x2611_16458_zeroFree P N =
  Polynomial.X * x2611_16458_blockPolynomialProduct P N)) ∧ (∀ (V : Type*) [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (S T : Set V) (a b : V)
  (hab : a ≠ b) (he : G.Adj a b) (hcover : S ∪ T = Set.univ)
  (hinter : S ∩ T = {a, b})
  (hedges : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w →
  (v ∈ S ∧ w ∈ S) ∨ (v ∈ T ∧ w ∈ T)), Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.X - 1) * x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥ =
  x2611_16458_zeroFree (G.induce S) ⊥ *
  x2611_16458_zeroFree (G.induce T) ⊥) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro V _ P N
    constructor
    · intro S T u hcover hinter hedges
      apply x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux1
      intro n
      have hc : Nat.card (ZMod (2 * (n + 1))) = 2 * (n + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
      have h := x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux2
        (C := ZMod (2 * (n + 1))) (n + 1 : ℕ) P N S T u hcover hinter hedges
      rw [hc] at h
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux3]
      exact_mod_cast h
    · intro hconn
      letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
      apply x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux1
      intro n
      have hc : Nat.card (ZMod (2 * (n + 1))) = 2 * (n + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
      have h := x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux4
        (C := ZMod (2 * (n + 1))) (n + 1 : ℕ) P N hconn
      rw [hc] at h
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
        x2611_16458_blockPolynomialProduct, Polynomial.eval_prod,
        x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux3]
      exact_mod_cast h
  · intro V _ G S T a b hab he hcover hinter hedges
    apply x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux1
    intro n
    have hc : Nat.card (ZMod (2 * (n + 1))) = 2 * (n + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
    have h := x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux5 (C := ZMod (2 * (n + 1)))
      G S T a b hab he hcover hinter hedges
    rw [hc] at h
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_one, x2611_16458_lem2_1_aux6]
    have hn : 1 ≤ 2 * (n + 1) := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h
